hero.titleHighlight: someone who works with them every day
hero.text: Tools, architectural choices and news from the AI world, seen through the eyes of someone who uses them on real projects. In English and Italian.

about.title: Field experience, written for people who build
about.text1: Every article comes from a real project: a tool tried in production, an architectural choice that held up or did not, a piece of AI news looked at beyond the announcement.
about.text2: The goal is to give developers, tech leads and decision makers what they need to understand what really changes in their work, without hype and without shortcuts.

facts.label: Experience
facts.value: Enterprise development, cloud and technical leadership

facts.label: Topics
facts.value: Development, architecture, AI and project management

customers.subtitle: Who the author has worked with
customers.text: Over more than fifteen years the author of HeroHubs has worked with companies across different sectors, sometimes directly and sometimes as part of larger teams, contributing to the development of their technology solutions.

blog.subtitle: Latest articles
blog.text: Reflections on tools, architecture and artificial intelligence, written from real projects.

principles.title: The principles of the blog
principles.text: Five rules that apply to every article, from the first to the last.

items.title: From the field
items.text: Only what has been used on real projects, not what the slides promise.

items.title: Beyond the announcement
items.text: Every piece of news is read for what it changes in everyday work, not for the noise it makes.

items.title: Concreteness
items.text: Precise names, numbers and examples instead of generic formulas and vague promises.

items.title: Two languages
items.text: Every article is published in English and Italian, with the same content and the same care.

items.title: AI as a tool
items.text: Drafting and translation are AI-assisted, review and responsibility stay with the author.
